description_en: Updates the configuration information about the backup vault
description_zh: 更新备份仓库的配置信息
name: UpdateVault

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the backup vault. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 备份仓库名称。长度为1~64个字符
parameters.name: vault_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the backup vault. The description must be 0 to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 仓库描述信息。长度为0~255个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the immutable backup feature for storage vaults. After the immutable backup feature is enabled, backup vaults and all backup data cannot be deleted until the retention period expires. The immutable backup feature cannot be disabled after it is enabled. Only standard backup vaults and archive vaults support the immutable backup feature
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启存储库备份锁定功能。开启备份锁定后，备份库和备份库所有的备份数据在自动到期之前无法删除。开启备份锁定后，不支持关闭备份锁定。备份锁定仅对标准备份库和归档备份库有效
parameters.name: worm_enabled

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Code.description_en: The response code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Message.description_en: The returned message. If the request was successful, a success message is returned. If the request failed, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true表示成功。
false表示失败
